signal: AI-linked clerical reductions announced by two or more banks in the same province within one quarter
confirmation: Retrenchment/labour notification filed with the provincial manpower office, OR verified by the industry body (PERBANAS), corroborated by the employer's own public announcement
agency: OJK banking supervision office (confirms, it already holds the banking data) -> Kemnaker Pusat Pasar Kerja + BPJS Ketenagakerjaan JKP programme office (act)
action: Within 30 days: joint job fair + retraining places opened via Prakerja; JKP benefit access fast-tracked for affected clerical staff; OJK asks affected banks for a workforce-transition note
cost_lead_time: 30 days; cost not yet estimated - needs the instrument map (due 22 Nov) to price
verified_by: CRO draft - needs Akbar + mentor review
notes: DRAFT PROPOSAL, not a project decision. Why this sector: finance and insurance is Indonesia's anchor sector (1.65m employed, Aug 2025) and clerical support is the most exposed occupation group (93.9% had some exposure). Why this trigger needs no data series: JKP's occupation detail is unconfirmed and no public series links AI adoption to hires - so the trigger runs on events and notifications instead. Deploy 'consistent with AI-driven change', never 'caused by AI'. Blind spot to name on the record: once affected staff leave formal payroll, Indonesia has no series that follows them into informal work (87.74m informal vs 59.93m formal, Feb 2026). Figures trace to Akbar's Indonesia.pdf; the trigger design is CRO's proposal.
